name: vault-media
description: Catalog books, films, television, music, and games in an Obsidian vault as `type: work` notes under an `entertainment` domain, with metadata fetched from Open Library, MusicBrainz, TVmaze, Steam, TMDB, or IGDB and the owner's own rating and thoughts recorded verbatim beside it.

tools.name: vault_media
tools.description: Search media providers for a title and write a schema-valid `type: work` note under the vault's `entertainment` domain. Fetched metadata renders as a `## Details` body table; the owner's rating and thoughts are copied verbatim and are never inferred, composed, or supplied from a provider's score. Also maintains To Read / To Watch backlog list notes and promotes a row into a full note. Dry run is the default.
